verdict.rationale: OpenCode explicitly supports multi-session workflows ('Start multiple agents in parallel on the same project'), tabs for desktop, share links for sessions, and a headless server that a WebUI can connect to across multiple backends, which community evidence corroborates ('WebUI... can connect to multiple OpenCode backends at once'). This directly matches an engineering-lead managing multiple agent sessions from one unified workspace. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of team/organization-level oversight (e.g., viewing/managing sessions started by other engineers) and some reported bugs in session state restoration temper reliability.
